item.title: Iran vows to end U.S. naval blockade by "all available means"
item.description: Iran vows to force the U.S. to lift its blockade as Trump acknowledges the regime's increasing attacks, but says they've "done no damage."

item.title: FBI's national crime database targeted in hack, Trump says
item.description: President Donald Trump confirmed on Saturday that the FBI’s National Crime Information Center database was targeted in a hack.
